fusions.name: Thrown Shoe
fusions.desc: Hurls a worn shoe that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to leave it [Fatigued] for 6 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Stampede at a Walk
fusions.desc: Drives a plodding herd through a cone 6 tiles ahead, dealing 30 damage to everything in it plus 4% of a boss or elite's maximum health, and leaving each one [Slowed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Pack Beast
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to call a tireless beast that fights beside you for 20 seconds, striking for 5 damage every 1.5 seconds. Each strike has a 30% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Bottomless Wind
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you restore 4 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
